## Scrapper (CR 1/2)

This 6-legged, furry creatures scuttles toward you, saliva dripping from its mouth.  

**XP** 200  
N Tiny magical beast  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +2  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +1 natural, +2 size)  
**hp** 7 (1d10+2)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +4, **Will** +2  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** 4 claws +3 (1d2), bite +3 (1d3)  
**Space** 2-1/2 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 11, **Dex** 15, **Con** 14, **Int** 2, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 7  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** -1; **CMD** 9 (17 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Great Fortitude Skills Climb +12  


**Special Abilities**


**Antiseptic Saliva (Ex)** Scrappers are never at risk of contracting a disease through food. A scrapper can, as a full-round action, lick clean an injury that’s not older than 1 minute. If the licked creature has contracted a disease through this injury (a ghoul’s bite, for example), it can attempt a second saving throw against the disease with a +4 bonus. If the creature succeeds at this save, it is treated as if it made the original save.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary, pair  
**Treasure** incidental
